title: Chapter 166: Demonic Arms
content:
Chapter 166: Demonic Arms

Like Nagalong, Naga-chan is very straightforward. After a simple greeting, she ordered the Naga army to rest and wait. She took Nagalong and Host No. 3 to the front of the battle to talk about business.

"Nagalong, let's take a look at the list of needs provided by the Zerg!"

Naga-chan reached out to Nagalong, who immediately took out the list provided by the Zerg and handed it to Naga-chan.

Naga-chan took the list, glanced at it quickly, and said cheerfully: "No problem! As long as it is something my tribe has, within the scope of our ability, we can give it as a thank-you gift to our Zerg friends!"

"The Zerg's assistance is priceless to our tribe, and it cannot be valued!"

"Let's not talk about transactions between us! Nagalong, you are responsible for checking the list, counting it in the tribe, and doing our best to prepare a big gift for our Zerg friends!"

Naga-chan redefined the support for the Zerg, from a transaction to a mutual help.

It is difficult to value the support of the Zerg from a specific value. No matter how the value is evaluated, it is inappropriate. It is most appropriate to define this support as priceless.

In this way, no matter how much the Naga tribe gives to the Zerg, it is just a thank you, not a transaction of equal value.

Skipping the valuation link will save a lot of trouble.

The Naga tribe will do what they can and provide the Zerg with what they need. The Zerg can provide corresponding combat force support according to their own ideas.

If the Zerg feels that they have lost, they only need to find a reason to reduce the number of troops provided for support, so that the friendship between the two sides will not be affected by the issue of interests.

This method is actually what Wu Qing wants, but it is not suitable for the Zerg to propose.

This Naga elder can also see the problem. She is willing to have a long-term friendship with the Zerg in her heart, so she made such a proposal.

Of course, the Zerg has no objection to this.

Naga Long also told Naga about some details of the war, especially the combat details of the Zerg participating in the war, which made the Naga elder more curious about the Zerg.

"I am looking forward to seeing the performance of the Zerg army on the battlefield!"

"With the help of Zerg friends, our tribe can stabilize the front and launch a proper counterattack!"

"Those demon cubs follow us like dogs. We have to fight another counterattack before dark!"

When Naga said fighting, there was light in her eyes. She and Meng belonged to the same kind of people and were born to be on the battlefield!

Wu Qing also got some very important information from her words. The army of the demon tribe, the main opponent of the Naga tribe, was chasing them from behind. Before dark, the Zerg tribe had a chance to fight the legendary demon tribe.

The evil god camp, like the local races, is divided into many races. Many foreign races are very strong and their beliefs are also different.

The evil gods in the evil god camp are also countless, some strong and some weak.

The bear goblins believe in the spirit god, and the demon tribe, the main opponent of the Naga tribe, believes in the upper demon. They are not a race of the same system, but belong to the same camp and are considered an alliance.

Wu Qing learned that the Naga tribe faced three main types of demons, namely inferior demons, flame demons and dog demons.

There was no distinction between noble and humble in the demon tribe, and whoever was stronger was the superior.

Naga asked Nagalong to explain the characteristics of the three types of demon troops to Host No. 3 in detail, and introduced corresponding targeted tactics based on the advantages and disadvantages of the demon troops, so as to avoid discomfort in the first battle between the Zerg and the demon tribe.

Sure enough, before Nagalong's introduction was finished, a scout came to report that the demon army had arrived nearby.

"Come well! Today they will come and never return!"

"Prepare for war!"

Naga picked up her weapon, and she looked up and said to Host No. 3 floating in the air: "The Zerg troops are self-contained. We are not subordinate to each other and fight in coordination!"

Her meaning was very clear. She was not familiar with the Zerg, so the two armies fought each other, which would be more efficient.

As long as they pay attention to mutual coordination, experienced commanders can adapt to the situation and seize the opportunity.

Through simple contact and understanding, she has seen the character of the Zerg. The Zerg fights more actively than she does, and their fighting style is fierce and merciless. They are like a group of cold war weapons, and she doesn't need to worry about them at all.

Moreover, she is more confident in her own strength. As long as the Zerg is not too outrageous, she can take this opportunity to see the performance of the Zerg in person.

"Please rest assured, elder!"

Host No. 3 responded.

The entire Zerg army, countless Zerg puppies, did not need verbal orders at all, and all moved instantly.

This silent command surprised Naga, but she did not ask, and turned to join the main force of the Naga tribe to personally command the army to fight.

The troops of the various territories of the Naga tribe on the battlefield, the survivors of the war continued to rest, and the newly arrived reinforcements joined the battlefield cleaning team. They did not need to play in the battle with the demon tribe.

The two powerful armies of the Naga tribe and the Zerg puppies quickly took action, arranged their troops on the left and right, and waited for the arrival of the demon tribe army.

After the formation was set, Wu Qing saw a large number of strange creatures with black red skin appearing on the horizon through the No. 3 host flying high in the sky.

Their skin was black and red, their bodies were hunched, their limbs were slender and powerful, they had claws, and they had a pair of demon horns on their heads, which were the most numerous inferior demons in the demon clan.

They are about two meters tall. According to Nagalon's introduction, the fighting style of the inferior demons is similar to that of the ghouls. They rely on demon claws for attack and demon skin, strong physical fitness, and self-healing recovery ability for defense.

The inferior demons mainly rely on physical close combat and have very strong fighting instincts. They are the main combat arms of the demon clan, and their individual combat power is stronger than that of the elite soldiers of the bear goblins.

There is no need to worry about the current combat power of the Zerg puppies against the inferior demons.

The other two arms in the demon army need to be more careful when facing the Zerg puppies.

One is the flame demon mixed in the inferior demons, and the other is the dog demon that looks like a giant dog.

The flame demon looks similar to the inferior demon, but it has a pair of demon wings and its skin is redder.

Their flesh wings can only jump and glide for short distances, and will not allow them to fly. Their red bodies contain a large amount of fire elements. They rely on their own innate abilities to launch long-range fireball attacks.

According to Nagalon's description, the fireball attack of the flame demon is as powerful as a cannonball, and it is a very terrifying long-range soldier.

Moreover, they like to hide in the inferior demons, which is very difficult to clean up, and usually brings great trouble on the battlefield.

The last kind of dog demon is a hairless, black and red giant dog with many obvious demon characteristics. It is a giant beast with a height of more than two meters and a body length of nearly five meters.

This is the most terrifying of the three demon soldiers. It is huge in size, has a very strong ability in close combat, and can also spit flames to attack. It can be said to be an all-round magic warrior with amazing combat power.

The strength of the dog demon is one star or above.

...

As the demon army gets closer and closer, Wu Qing feels that their number is not much less than the number of the combined army of the Zerg and Naga.

Compared with the army of the bear goblins, the command of the demon army is not so sophisticated. Like the Zerg, it seems more scattered, but it also has its own unique command method.

"Wu La Wa La *\u0026%%..."

The noise coming from the demon army can be heard from afar, which seems very scattered, but their marching speed is not slow.

The battle between the camps is life and death, there is no reason to talk, and there is no need for dialogue in front of the battle.

"Shoot!"

With the order of Naga in front of the battle, countless arrows shot out from the square formation of the Naga army, shooting at the demon army that rushed over without stopping.

The longbow of the Naga tribe has a very long range, and the arrows with heavy arrows are very powerful in long-range projection.

The rain of arrows fell, and a large number of inferior demons were hit by arrows and fell to the ground. More inferior demons avoided the vital points. Relying on their strong physical fitness and recovery ability, they directly pulled out the arrows and continued to charge, which was very fierce.

The rain of arrows from the Naga army continued, and the demon army continued to charge against the rain of arrows, quickly closing the distance between the two sides.

The Zerg did not have a hydralisk sitting in the camp, and lost its long-range attack ability. The Zerg puppies could only watch at this time.

When the distance between the two sides was shortened to a certain extent, the flame demons mixed in the inferior demons began to attack.

They put their hands together, and their innate fire control ability allowed them to easily form a big fireball between their palms.

They pushed their palms forward and pushed the big fireball out. Under the control of their innate ability, the big fireball flew at high speed and crashed into the Naga army and Zerg puppies in front.

"Boom...! Boom...!"

Wu Qing seemed to hear the long-lost sound of artillery shells!

The energy impact of the fireball explosion, high temperature burns and flying debris can all cause damage. Experienced Naga warriors will cooperate and use shields to resist damage.

This is also the reason why Naga warriors are equipped with shields and equipped with fine food armor. Without these equipment, they will suffer a lot when facing the attack of the flame demon.

The defense of the Zerg depends entirely on the shell and physical fitness. The Zerg puppies directly attacked by the fireball will curl up on the ground to reduce the damage caused by the explosion.

The Zerg in the game have to face the powerful artillery attacks of the Terrans at all times. The combat experience engraved in their genes makes them very skilled in dealing with such attacks.

In the end, the damage caused by the small number of flame demons was very limited.

However, it is not the character of the Zerg to passively take a beating. When they saw that the demons could counterattack, more than 180,000 Zerg puppies attacked in full force!

In the eyes of the Zerg, there are resources in front. If they fight all of them, they must grab more resources back!

Naga, who was in front of the Naga formation, frowned when she saw the Zerg army attacking the battle directly.

"Continue the long-range projectiles to suppress the enemy's rear support!"

"Move the rear formation to the right and support the battle in front of the formation!"

Naga moved the troops behind the Naga army to the position where the Zerg army was originally lined up to provide long-range support nearby.
